summary: Iteration 15 - Web Push (PWA) + Campaign analytics (email open/click + push click tracking). Backend: 11/12 pytest passed (91.7%) in /app/backend/tests/test_iter15_push_campaigns.py. Verified GET /api/push/vapid-public-key (non-empty), POST /api/push/subscribe (upsert - no dupe on repeat), POST /api/push/unsubscribe, GET /api/admin/push/count (401 without auth, correct count with auth), POST /api/push/subscribe with invalid payload -> 400. Verified email open tracking (GIF 200, dedupe: two hits -> email_opened=1 not 2), email click tracking (302 to campaign.link, email_clicked=1, email_opened=1 because click implies open), push click tracking (302, push_clicked=1, email_clicked NOT incremented), invalid click -> 404, invalid open -> still returns 200 image/gif (privacy-safe). Verified admin campaigns list requires auth, publishing article/event with published:true auto-creates a campaign row via _announce background task, with email_sent=0 push_sent=0 as expected (0 active subscribers, 0 push subscriptions). Campaign list sorted newest-first. Frontend Playwright: sidebar admin-tab-campaigns switches to CampaignsManager, 5 summary stat cards render (Emails Sent, Opened, Email Clicks, Push Sent, Push Clicks) with correct % calculations (5/10=50% open, 2/10=20% click, 1/3=33% push click), push-subscriber-count shows '0 devices subscribed to push', campaign-row-0 renders with kind badge + all counters + date, and articles tab shows data-testid='campaign-inline' underneath the article that has a campaign with 'Email 10 sent · 5 opened (50%) · 2 clicked (20%) Push 3 sent · 1 clicked (33%)'. Cleanup verified: 0 QA articles/events/campaigns/recipients/push subs remain in DB.

critical.issue: Manual notify endpoints call _send_newsletter directly instead of _announce, so they do NOT create a new campaign row and do NOT dispatch web push. Per review request expectation ('each create an additional campaign row'), this is broken. Result: manual re-notify sends emails but produces zero tracking analytics (no campaign, no recipients with tokens, no open/click tracking on those emails). Also skips push entirely.

minor.issue: When campaign row exists but has no 'link' field for any reason, RedirectResponse falls back to url='/' which under FastAPI's RedirectResponse becomes a redirect to '/' relative to the request host. Not exploitable but consider redirecting to a safe absolute URL (e.g., public_base()) if link is missing/empty.

No auth/rate-limit. Anyone can POST arbitrary VAPID subscriptions with any keys. If keys don't correspond to a real endpoint, subsequent _send_push will just fail per-sub (handled) - low impact - but a malicious client can bloat push_subscriptions collection. Consider a lightweight abuse guard (per-IP rate limit) or storing user_agent for admin visibility.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): Update /api/admin/articles/{aid}/notify and /api/admin/events/{eid}/notify to schedule bg.add_task(_announce, kind, doc, public_base(request)) instead of _send_newsletter directly, so each manual notify creates its own campaign row (with tracking) AND dispatches web push - matches the auto-publish path and the review-request spec.
(Optional) Validate subscription.keys shape (p256dh + auth non-empty strings) before upserting into push_subscriptions.
(Optional) Add index on campaigns.created_at desc for list_campaigns sort at scale (currently indexed only on ref_id).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _announce awaits _send_newsletter and _send_push sequentially inside the background task; if _send_newsletter raises (e.g., Resend outage), _send_push never runs. Consider try/except around each dispatcher so a partial failure doesn't skip the other channel.
_send_newsletter+_send_push each insert campaign_recipients one-by-one in a loop; for 10k+ subscribers this is N round-trips. Consider bulk insert_many(chunks).

track_click uses HTTPException(404) if the token row is missing; but the /track/open path silently returns a GIF for unknown tokens (privacy-safe / mail-client-safe). That is the correct asymmetry, worth a code comment for future maintainers.

Push subscriptions store 'email' lowercased but stripping to None if empty; if the same browser subscribes twice with different email values, the second overwrites the first (via update_one on endpoint) - probably intended.

NotifyBell/push.js: browser push permission can't be tested headless (skipped intentionally). Ensure lib/push.js gracefully handles Notification.permission='denied' and 'default' without console errors - not tested this round.

rca of the issue: Manual notify handlers were written before campaign-tracking existed and were not updated when _announce() was introduced. They still bg.add_task(_send_newsletter, kind, doc, public_base(request)) with NO campaign_id argument, so _send_newsletter uses its default '' path that skips campaign_recipients insertion and skips the email_sent counter update. Consequence: (a) no campaign row created, (b) email is sent but no open/click tracking pixel or tracked link (tokens are only generated when campaign_id truthy), (c) push notification is never triggered from the manual notify path. Fix: replace both bg.add_task calls with bg.add_task(_announce, kind, doc, public_base(request)) and drop the subscribers count from the response (or compute it after).
